issue: GEM records Tema FSRU as Status=operating / Substatus=actual, but multiple independent 2024-2025 sources indicate the terminal had NOT yet come online / received first commercial cargo as of mid-2025. The IGU 2025 World LNG Report lists the start year as 2025 (i.e. not-yet-started when GIIGNL 2024 was compiled); GIIGNL's 2024 report (June 2024) still listed it as under construction; the Ghanaian oil regulator in Feb 2024 said it expected completion 'by the end of the year' with LNG supply secured from Equatorial Guinea. Earliest 'awaiting first cargo' reporting dates to May 2021 (Reganosa ready, awaiting Shell-GNPC first-delivery agreement), and the project has slipped repeatedly since. No verified primary source confirming an actual first cargo / commercial start was found in this discovery sweep. The operating/actual status may be premature or may reflect a 2025/2026 start not yet corroborated by a primary source.
suggested_action: Route to an Update batch for status verification (fetch_timeline was DOWN during this sweep so the existing status timeline could not be pulled). Confirm whether Tema FSRU has actually received first cargo / declared commercial operations; if not yet operating, the correct status is likely construction (or commissioning) with the appropriate anchor year, not operating/actual. Cross-check against the IGU 2025 report start-year=2025 entry and any 2025-2026 first-cargo announcement before changing the live cell.
